invariants.statement: A reservation transitions from active to cancelled at most once.
Repeating the same cancellation idempotency key for the same reservation has no additional side effect.
A cancellation idempotency key cannot target a different reservation.
A nonexistent reservation cannot create cancellation state.
Cancelled reservations are excluded from active overlap checks.
Original booking invariants remain true after the extension.
